questions.text: 男人说"Good morning. My name is Tom. I'm from London." 问题：这个男人叫什么名字？
女人说"I would like a cup of coffee, please." 问题：这个女人想要什么？
男人说"The book is on the table." 问题：书在哪里？
女人说"I have two children, a boy and a girl." 问题：这个女人有几个孩子？
男人说"It's 3 o'clock. Time to go home." 问题：现在几点了？
男人说"I usually go to work by bus, but today I'm walking because the bus is late." 问题：这个男人通常怎么去上班？
女人说"Can you buy some milk and bread on your way home?" 问题：女人想让男人买什么？
男人说"I enjoy playing tennis on weekends with my friends." 问题：男人什么时候打网球？
女人说"The restaurant opens at 6:30 PM and closes at 10:00 PM." 问题：餐厅什么时候关门？
男人说"I have a headache, so I'm going to take some medicine." 问题：男人怎么了？
女人说"I've been learning English for about three years." 问题：这个女人学英语多久了？
男人说"If the weather is nice this weekend, we could go to the beach." 问题：天气好的话他们会做什么？
女人说"I prefer to shop online because it's more convenient." 问题：女人为什么喜欢网购？
男人说"The company is looking for someone with at least five years of experience." 问题：公司要求几年的工作经验？
女人说"Although I was tired, I decided to finish the report before going to bed." 问题：女人什么时候做完报告？
男人说"The government has announced plans to build a new hospital in the city center." 问题：政府计划建什么？
女人说"What I find most challenging about learning a new language is not the grammar, but actually having the confidence to speak." 问题：女人觉得学语言最难的是什么？
男人说"The lecture was supposed to start at 9, but we began half an hour late." 问题：演讲几点开始的？
女人说"The company managed to increase its market share by focusing on innovation and customer service." 问题：公司如何增加市场份额？
options: By focusing on innovation and customer service
questions.correct_answer: By focusing on innovation and customer service

questions.text: 男人说"The professor suggested that we read the first three chapters before the next class." 问题：教授建议读几章？

sections.title: 口语表达
sections.description: 根据提示进行口语表达（文字输入）

questions.text: 请用英语自我介绍（姓名、年龄、国籍）
请说出你所在城市的3个地点（如学校、医院、公园）
请用英语描述你今天的早餐
请说出你最喜欢的颜色并用英语表达
请描述你的家庭成员（至少3人）
请用英语描述你上个周末做了什么
请说出你最喜欢的食物并说明原因
请描述你住的房子或公寓
请用英语介绍一个你喜欢的节日并说明为什么喜欢
请描述一次你难忘的旅行经历
请用英语说明你每天的学习/工作安排
请说出一个你想去旅行的地方并说明原因
请用英语讨论：科技对现代生活的影响
请用英语表达你对"远程办公"的看法
请用英语描述一个你曾经面对的挑战并说明你是如何应对的
阅读："My name is Anna. I am 25. I live in New York." 问题：Anna住在哪里？
阅读："Tom has a dog. The dog's name is Max." 问题：Tom有什么宠物？
阅读："The shop opens at 9 and closes at 6." 问题：商店几点开门？
阅读："I like apples. I don't like oranges." 问题：这个人喜欢什么？
阅读："Sarah works in a hospital. She is a nurse." 问题：Sarah做什么工作？
阅读："There are four seasons. I like summer because I can go swimming." 问题：作者为什么喜欢夏天？
阅读："Many people enjoy traveling to other countries. When you travel, you can learn about different cultures." 问题：人们为什么喜欢旅行？
阅读："Many people enjoy traveling. However, traveling can also be expensive." 问题：旅行的缺点是什么？
阅读："Scientists agree that human activities are contributing to global warming." 问题：气候变化的主要原因是什么？
阅读："Many countries are investing in renewable energy sources like solar and wind power." 问题：许多国家正在投资什么？
阅读："To reduce the impact, many countries are investing in renewable energy sources like solar and wind power." 问题：文中提到的可再生能源有哪些？
